在可信边界做最小权限和参数校验，批准仅覆盖明确动作。: Enforce least privilege and bounded approvals at a trusted boundary.
已批准给订单A退款20元，模型随后请求给B退款20元。应怎样处理？: Approval covers refunding A by 20; the next request refunds B by 20. What should happen?
拒绝或重新取得针对B的有效批准: Deny or obtain valid B-specific approval
金额相同不代表对象相同，原批准不覆盖B。: Equal amounts do not make the approved object interchangeable.
把B改名为A再执行: Rename B to A and execute
设计查订单、退款预览、实际退款三种能力及超时后恢复规则。: Design order-read, refund-preview and refund-execution permissions with timeout recovery.
读取核主体/订单范围；预览无付款副作用；执行需绑定订单金额的有效确认与幂等键。超: Authorize reads, keep preview side-effect-free, bind execution approval and idempotency to order/amount, and reconcile uncertain receipts before retry.
工具、参数、主体和资源范围分别验证。: Tool, arguments, principal and resource scope are separately validated.
读/预览/写分开，确认与重试不能扩大授权。: Read, preview and write are distinct; approval and retries remain bounded.
分类阈值：找回更多与打扰更多的取舍: Thresholds: recover more cases at a review cost
精确率以预测为正的样本为分母，回答“我提醒的有多少真需处理”；召回率以真实正类为: Precision measures positives among alerts; recall measures recovered true positives. Accuracy can conceal misses when positives are rare.
降低阈值通常让更多样本被判正，但是否提升召回、增加多少误报必须在同一评估集上测量: Measure threshold effects on a fixed evaluation set. Error costs and reviewer capacity determine trade-offs; do not tune repeatedly against final-test data.
两种阈值各占用多少人工复查: Two thresholds impose different review workloads
合成评估集真实正例10个。阈值T1检出8个真例、4个误报；T2检出6个真例、1个: The synthetic set has ten positives. T1 yields 8 true positives/4 false alarms; T2 yields 6/1.
T1提醒12个，T2提醒7个；真实正例始终10个。精确率的分母随提醒数变，召回率: Alert counts are 12 and 7, while actual positives remain 10.
T1 precision 66.67%,recall 80%; T2 precision 85.71%,recall 60%, with two additional misses.
若这同一批样本最多能人工复查7个，T1的12个提醒超容量，T2的7个在容量内；若: If review capacity for this same batch is seven cases, T1’s 12 alerts exceed it while T2’s seven fit. Costly misses may still make T2 insufficient. Offline batch counts do not directly imply daily volume; consider capacity or triage changes and retest on relevant workloads and independent data.
同时列真例、误报、漏检和复查量，让阈值取舍可讨论，而不是只选较高百分比。: Report positives, false alarms, misses and review volume rather than choosing one impressive percentage.
把precision=85.71%当成找回了85.71%的所有风险。: Interpret 85.71% precision as recovering 85.71% of all risks.
这把预测正类分母换成了真实正类；T2实际召回只有60%。: This substitutes the recall denominator; T2 actually recovers 60%.
每个百分比旁保留TP/FP/FN及算式，再讨论成本。: Retain counts and denominators next to each metric.
合成TP=9、FP=3、FN=6。精确率和召回率分别是多少？: With TP 9,FP 3,FN 6, what are precision and recall?
召回应包含漏掉的6个真例，不能继续用12作分母。: Recall must include the six missed positives.
阈值A：TP12/FP8；B：TP9/FP1，真实正例15。写两组指标和一个有条: A:TP 12/FP 8; B:TP 9/FP 1; actual positives 15. Compare metrics and a conditional decision.
A精确60%、召回80%、复查20；B精确90%、召回60%、复查10。选择依漏: A:60% precision,80% recall,20 reviews; B:90%,60%,10. Choose by costs/capacity and retain independent evaluation.
两指标分母与零分母处理明确。: Denominators and undefined cases are explicit.
决策理由包含漏检、误报和容量，不只看单项最大。: Decisions consider misses, false alarms and capacity.
评测用例：先写什么算通过，再看答案: Evaluation cases: define success before reading outputs
一条评测用例包括输入、预期行为、可接受变化、失败条件和严重度。开放表达可以有多种: A case specifies input, expected behavior, tolerance, failure and severity. Wording may vary while facts and authorization remain testable. Retrofitting the rubric to candidate answers undermines evaluation.
平均分与阻断门槛分工不同。八个普通用例做对不能抵消一次受控资料泄漏；严重度应在评: An average does not override a predeclared blocking failure. Small suites establish only their covered scenarios, and ambiguous ratings need recorded rationales.
同样80%通过率，发布判断为什么不同: Why an 80% pass rate can still block release
合成10个工单助手用例，8通过；2失败分别为普通格式错误与受限信息泄漏。预先规则: Ten synthetic cases produce eight passes, one format failure and one restricted-information leak. A predeclared gate requires zero leaks.
逐例保存输入、输出与评分依据；确认“泄漏”对应原文实际披露受限片段，不只因用了某: Retain inputs, outputs and evidence; verify actual restricted disclosure rather than matching a vague keyword.
普通通过率8/10=80%，严重泄漏1次。两项同时报告，不能只保留80%或把泄漏: Report 80% pass rate and one severe leak separately.
泄漏数1不满足0门槛，因此阻断本轮发布；修复后回归泄漏例，并另找独立权限情境验证: The release gate fails. Repair and regress the case, then add an independent authorization scenario without weakening the gate.
评测交付是一组有依据的案例判定、汇总及门槛结果，不是一句“模型80分”。: Deliver evidence-backed case decisions, aggregates and gate outcomes, not a single opaque score.
泄漏只有一例，为让平均分好看把它从样本删掉。: Remove the leak case to improve the average.
删除已知失败会掩盖风险，且改变了预先评测范围。: This conceals known risk and changes the evaluation scope.
保留错例与严重度，修复后回归并用新例测迁移。: Retain severity, regress repaired cases and test independent scenarios.
20例中19例通过，唯一失败是预先定义的越权阻断项。能否仅按95%发布？: Nineteen of 20 pass; the only failure is a predeclared authorization blocker. Is 95% enough to release?
平均通过率不能覆盖独立的阻断门槛。: An aggregate threshold does not override a blocking gate.
会隐藏已知越权问题。: This hides a known authorization failure.
不能，先修复阻断项并复验: No; repair and retest the blocking item
按预先约定同时看平均指标与严重错误门槛。: Both aggregate metrics and severe-error gates apply.
为只允许未发货取消的助手，写正常、已发货、订单缺失、越权四种用例的可观察预期。: Create normal, shipped, missing-order and unauthorized cases for cancellation allowed only before shipping.
正常经授权可生成取消预览；已发货不冒充可取消；缺订单保持未知/澄清；越权不披露或: Specify authorized preview, shipped refusal, missing-order clarification and no unauthorized disclosure/action, with evidence and severity.
用例包含输入、预期、容许差异及失败证据。: Cases include input, expected behavior, tolerance and failure evidence.
严重度和发布门槛先定义，错例不被事后删除。: Severity and gates are declared before evaluation and failures remain.
失败分析：沿证据链定位，不凭答案猜原因: Failure review: trace evidence instead of guessing from an answer
错误答案是现象，不是原因。同一句过期答复，既可能因为检索到了旧文档，也可能因为新: An incorrect answer is an observation, not a root cause. An outdated response may result from stale retrieval or from ignoring a current retrieved source. Link input, document versions, ranking, tool calls and output; missing evidence leaves the cause unresolved.
修复必须对应失效环节。检索漏掉新文档，优先检查索引与筛选；明明有证据却答错，检查: Repair the failed stage: inspect indexing and filters for missing evidence, and grounding or validation when correct evidence was available. Prioritize impact as well as frequency; one unauthorized disclosure can outweigh several formatting failures.
把一条旧政策答复追到可验证环节: Trace an outdated policy answer to a verifiable stage
合成日志：问题为“7月5日购买适用几天退货”；文库P1旧版为30天，P2自7月1: Synthetic log: the user asks about a July 5 purchase. P1 is the old 30-day policy; P2 applies from July 1 and allows 14 days. Retrieval returns both, ranking P2 first. The answer says 30 days and cites P1.
P2存在且已被检索到，因此“索引没有新政策”不受这条日志支持。保存两份版本、生效: P2 exists and was retrieved, so this log does not support a missing-index diagnosis. Retain versions, dates, ranking and citations.
可定位为答案使用证据与生效时间约束的失败；仅凭日志还不能断言是某条提示、模型能力: The observed failure concerns evidence use and effective dates. The log alone does not establish a specific prompt, model or randomness as the sole cause. Add explicit applicability validation.
同例修复预期为14天；再用6月20日购买的新例检验旧版30天仍适用，避免把所有答: The repaired July case should use 14 days; a June 20 purchase should still select 30 days. This checks against simply hard-coding 14.
得到的是有证据的失效位置与可复验修复方案；是否根治仍要看回归和独立样本。: The result is an evidence-backed failure location and testable repair, not proof of a universal fix.
答案错了就统一调低温度，并声称已修复知识问题。: Lower temperature for every wrong answer and declare the knowledge issue fixed.
温度不能补回缺失索引或自动决定政策适用版本，变化后偶然答对也不说明根因消失。: Temperature does not repair an index or decide policy applicability; one improved output does not establish root-cause removal.
先保留链路证据、划分失效位置，再设计覆盖修复点与相邻边界的回归。: Retain the trace, locate the failed stage and test both the repair and neighboring boundaries.
日志显示新政策根本未被检索返回，首要核查什么？: A trace shows that the current policy was never retrieved. What should be investigated first?
索引收录、生效筛选和检索召回: Index coverage, effective-date filters and retrieval
缺证据首先发生在检索链路；确认这一段后再分析生成。: The missing evidence originates in retrieval; investigate that stage before generation.
可能掩盖问题并破坏旧政策仍适用的情境。: This conceals the fault and breaks legitimately older cases.
字数不能解释文档为什么没被返回。: Length does not explain missing retrieval.
一个助手答复超出所选文档范围。列出你需要保存的链路信息，并提出两种可被日志区分的: Specify trace evidence and two distinguishable hypotheses for an answer beyond selected documents.
保存所选文档ID/版本、实际召回、工具输出与答案引用。若越界文档被召回，查过滤权: Save selected IDs/versions, retrieval, tool output and citations. Distinguish unauthorized retrieval from unsupported generation, then design targeted and adjacent tests.
原因必须对应可观察证据，未知环节明确标记。: Causes are tied to observations and missing evidence is acknowledged.
修复措施与失效环节相符，并验证没有破坏相邻正常情境。: Repairs match the failed stage and preserve neighboring valid behavior.
可复现记录：让比较有共同起点: Reproducibility: give comparisons a shared starting point
可复现首先是记录足够信息，使别人知道你比较了什么。代码相同但数据、模型版本或提示: Reproducibility begins with enough information to identify the comparison. Identical code with different data, model or prompt is a different experiment. Record input snapshots or hashes, code, prompt, model, parameters and scoring rules; sensitive material needs controlled storage rather than public logs.
固定随机种子能控制部分随机过程，却不保证所有硬件、库或托管服务逐字一致。应预先区: A seed controls some randomness, not every library, device or hosted service. Define acceptable numerical tolerance or semantic behavior in advance. Where a provider cannot pin a backend version, disclose the limitation and preserve the actual output.
两次“同代码”运行为什么不能直接比较: Why identical code is not enough for a fair comparison
合成运行A：数据快照d1为100例，提示p1，模型m1，评分规则r1，正确80例: Synthetic run A uses data d1 with 100 cases, prompt p1, model m1 and rubric r1:80 correct. Run B uses d2 with 120 cases and p2, the same model and rubric:102 correct. No other runs exist.
A为80/100=80%，B为102/120=85%。可报告这两次各自的观察结果: A scores 80% and B85%. These are valid observations for their respective runs, not an isolated prompt effect.
数据集与提示同时变化，5个百分点可能来自难度分布、提示或交互作用。建立清单：da: Data and prompt both changed. Difficulty mix, prompt or interaction may explain the gap. Record hashes, versions and outputs.
下一轮在同一保留快照d1及规则r1下分别运行p1与p2，其他可控条件固定并记录。: Compare p1 and p2 on the same retained d1 and r1 with other controllable conditions fixed. This new experiment has not yet been run and has no score.
现有证据支持“A80%，B85%，比较存在混杂”，并给出下一轮可追溯的实验清单。: The evidence supports 80% versus 85% with confounding, plus a traceable plan for the next comparison.
只保存最终分数和一个随机种子，称任何人都能精确复现。: Save only the score and seed and promise exact reproduction.
别人无法恢复数据、提示与实际模型；种子也不是跨环境完全一致的保证。: Neither inputs nor configuration can be reconstructed, and a seed is not a cross-environment identity guarantee.
保存版本清单、输入引用、原始输出与评分依据；明确容差和无法固定的依赖。: Preserve the manifest, input references, outputs and scoring evidence; disclose tolerances and unpinned dependencies.
两次同模型评测分数不同，但未保存测试集版本。当前能得出什么？: The same model receives different scores, but test-set versions were not saved. What can be concluded?
缺少输入一致性的证据，无法把差异归因于模型。: Without matching inputs, the difference cannot be assigned to the model.
暂不能归因，先补齐输入与配置记录: Attribution is unresolved; recover inputs and configuration
先确认比较对象相同，才能分析模型或流程变化。: Establish comparability before assigning a cause.
会隐藏观察结果，也不能补齐缺失记录。: This hides evidence without repairing missing records.
为一轮文档问答对照写最小运行清单，并说明哪些信息可公开、哪些只保存受控引用。: Write a minimal manifest for document QA and separate public fields from controlled references.
记录案例集哈希、文档版本、提示版本、模型标识、代码/环境、参数、时间、输出与评分: Record case and document versions, prompt, model, code/environment, parameters, time, output and rubric. Publish only safe configuration and aggregates; retain sensitive inputs under access control.
清单能区分数据、配置、评分变化，不以种子代替全部记录。: The manifest separates data, configuration and rubric changes; a seed is not the entire record.
明确比较标准、访问范围及不能固定的外部依赖。: Comparison criteria, access scope and unpinned dependencies are explicit.
上线监控：区分人群变了与同类表现变差: Monitoring: separate population shift from within-group deterioration
监控需要把服务运行与任务质量分开：错误率、延迟、费用能发现服务异常，不能单独证明: Operational signals such as errors, latency and cost do not prove task correctness. Quality needs labels, delayed outcomes or verifiable evidence. An unlabeled input shift is a review trigger, not proof of degradation or continued accuracy.
整体指标也会随用户组成变化。即使新旧两类用户各自表现完全不变，只要更难的一类占比: Aggregates change with population mix. A larger share of a harder group can increase overall error even when each group is unchanged. Inspect group counts, group rates and aggregates together, and disclose small samples or incomplete labels.
整体错误率升高，不等于所有场景都退化: A higher aggregate error need not mean within-group regression
合成已标注样本：上周普通问题90例错9例、复杂问题10例错4例；本周普通50例错: Labeled synthetic data: last week,90 simple cases with 9 errors and 10 complex with 4. This week,50 simple with 5 errors and 50 complex with 20. Labeling is consistent; the example is descriptive.
两周普通错误率均为10%；复杂均为40%。现有分组数据没有显示组内错误率变差。: Simple cases are 10% wrong in both weeks and complex cases 40% in both. These observations show no within-group rate change.
上周总错13/100=13%，本周25/100=25%。复杂问题占比从10%升至: Overall error rises from 13% to 25% as complex cases increase from 10% to 50%; the observed mix shift explains this example.
调查复杂需求增长原因，并为复杂问题增加转人工或改进检索的评估；持续保留分组标注。: Investigate complex demand and assess escalation or retrieval improvements. Continue group labeling; neither claim model regression from the aggregate alone nor ignore poorer overall experience.
报告整体13%→25%、组内10%/40%未变及复杂占比10%→50%，并明确后: Report the aggregate change, stable group rates and changed mix, together with the next investigation.
只看25%就回滚模型，或只看组内稳定就说服务没有问题。: Roll back solely because of 25%, or dismiss the problem because group rates are stable.
前者可能误判原因，后者忽略更多用户遇到困难场景的事实。: The first can misattribute cause; the second ignores the increased burden of harder cases.
把运行指标、分组质量、样本量和版本变化一同查看，再选择有证据的行动。: Review operations, group quality, sample sizes and version changes before selecting an action.
新问题类型占比明显增多，但还没有正确性标签。现在最合理的判断是？: A new query type becomes common, but correctness labels are unavailable. What is justified?
模型错误率已翻倍: The model error rate has doubled
输入分布不等于错误标签，不能计算尚未知的错误率。: Input mix is not a correctness label; the error rate is unknown.
没有报错就一定正确: No system error means correct answers
服务成功返回与任务正确是两件事。: Successful delivery and task correctness differ.
标记分布变化并抽样复核，暂不下准确率结论: Flag the shift and sample for review; defer accuracy claims
可以观察到变化，质量结论仍需有代表性的证据。: The shift is observable, while quality needs representative evidence.
为知识助手定义三个监控信号，分别对应运行、质量和权限，并写清触发后由谁做什么。: Define operational, quality and authorization monitors for a knowledge assistant, including owners and responses.
运行：持续延迟超约定窗口由值班者查依赖；质量：分组标注的有据答复率下降由内容负责: Use an owned latency response, labeled group-quality review and immediate containment for confirmed restricted disclosure, with declared windows and evidence requirements.
运行成功、答案正确与权限安全分别监测，信号有适用窗口和分母。: Operations, correctness and authorization are separate signals with explicit windows and denominators.
行动能对应证据、负责人和恢复条件，未知质量不写成已验证。: Actions have evidence, owners and recovery conditions; unknown quality is not called verified.
人工复核：让人有证据、有范围、能叫停: Human oversight: evidence, scoped authority and a real stop
人工复核有效的前提是人能看见决策依据、理解影响并有权限拒绝。只在按钮旁写“人工确: Oversight requires evidence, understandable consequences and the authority to refuse. A confirmation label without original evidence, target or editable scope encourages rubber-stamping. High-impact actions need a preview showing the target, action and proposed changes for an accountable reviewer.
批准有边界和时效。对订单A退20元的批准，不能复用于订单B或更高金额；批准后关键: Approval has scope and lifetime. Approval for a20-unit refund on A does not authorize B or a higher amount. Material state changes require renewed review. Record the person, evidence and approved version, with workable pause, cancellation and recovery paths.
一次退款预览怎样交给人判断: Give a reviewer a concrete refund preview
合成情境：订单A已支付100元、未发货；客户申请退20元；操作者有A的退款权限。: Synthetic scenario: A was paid 100, is unshipped and requests 20 back. The operator is authorized for A. The system only previews a refund. Before approval, A changes to shipped; the local rule requires specialist review for shipped orders.
预览列订单A、支付100、拟退款20、预计余额80、权限结果及规则版本，且明确尚: Preview A, paid 100, proposed 20, remaining 80, authorization and rule version, clearly marked unexecuted.
最新状态已发货，与预览“未发货”不符；原预览失效。保持不执行，把状态变化和需专人: The latest shipped state conflicts with the preview. Invalidate it, execute nothing and show why specialist review is required.
保存预览版本、读取状态时间、复核人及“转专人”决定。只有新的适用规则、授权与复核: Record the preview version, state-read time, reviewer and escalation. Generate a new preview only after valid rules and authorization are established; no refund is claimed.
最终状态是“旧预览失效，转专人核实，未执行”，而非让一次确认覆盖变化后的订单。: The outcome is an invalidated preview, specialist escalation and no execution.
用户已经点过一次确认，以后金额或状态变化也沿用原批准。: Reuse one confirmation after the amount or state changes.
人批准的是特定对象与版本，变化后影响和适用规则可能都不同。: A person approves a particular target and version; changed conditions may alter consequences and rules.
把批准绑定对象、动作、金额和状态版本，关键变化时停止并重审。: Bind approval to target, action, amount and state version; stop and re-review material changes.
复核者看不到原始材料，只能点“同意AI建议”。最应先补什么？: A reviewer sees no evidence and can only agree with AI. What should be added first?
原始依据、具体动作预览及拒绝/修改路径: Original evidence, a concrete preview and refusal/edit paths
这些是独立判断与实际干预的必要条件。: These enable independent judgment and meaningful intervention.
按钮数量不能补足证据和决定权限。: More buttons provide neither evidence nor authority.
说明文字不能替代可检查依据和可操作的停止路径。: A notice does not replace evidence or a usable stop.
为“AI生成对外报告后由人发布”设计复核交接，列出需看证据和必须重新复核的变化。: Design a review handoff for an AI-drafted public report, including evidence and changes requiring renewed review.
交接报告版本、数据截点、来源链接、关键结论及限制；允许修订/拒绝，由指定发布人确: Hand over draft version, data cutoff, sources, claims and limitations, with editing/refusal by the named publisher. Changes to data, conclusions or disclosure invalidate prior approval; keep the approved preview and history.
复核者能检查证据并拒绝或修订，职责与实际执行相衔接。: The reviewer can inspect evidence, refuse or revise and has operational authority.
批准范围、失效条件和未执行状态清楚，记录可追溯。: Approval scope, invalidation conditions and execution status are explicit and traceable.
从域名到响应：找出请求停止的一层: From name to response: locate the failed stage
一次HTTPS请求通常先解析名称，再连接地址与端口，随后协商TLS，最后交换HT: An HTTPS request commonly resolves a name, connects to an address and port, negotiates TLS, then exchanges HTTP. A DNS answer does not establish reachability, and a connection does not establish certificate or application success. Separating stages makes the next investigation evidence-driven.
诊断记录至少要有时间、实际目标、失败阶段和原始错误。浏览器、代理与服务端可能经过: Record time, actual target, stage and original error. Browsers, proxies and servers may use different resolvers or caches. A successful request on another computer is not an equivalent control; keep name, network location and observation window comparable.
三条离线记录怎样缩小范围: Narrow the search using three offline records
合成记录R1：10:00，api.example.invalid解析为203.0: Synthetic R1 at 10:00 resolves api.example.invalid to 203.0.113.10. R2 times out connecting to port 443. R3 contains no TLS or HTTP event. The reserved address is for offline reading, not probing.
R1提供一次解析成功的证据，记录目标203.0.113.10。不要因此写“网站正: R1 establishes one successful resolution and its target. It does not establish a working website; only name resolution completed.
R2显示传输连接未在期限内建立，故障范围先放在连接路径或目标监听。TLS与HTT: R2 establishes that the connection was not formed within the deadline. Investigate path or listener availability before TLS or HTTP; there is no response code to interpret.
向获授权的运维人员核对同窗监听状态和连接日志：若目标没有监听，支持服务未就绪；若: Within authorization, obtain same-window listener and connection records. An absent listener supports an unavailable service; a healthy listener with no arriving connection directs attention to the path. Timeout alone cannot decide between them.
可交付的结论是“解析完成，443连接阶段超时，TLS/HTTP未验证”，并附R1: Report resolution completed, connection to 443 timed out, and TLS/HTTP remain unverified, with R1/R2 and two follow-up hypotheses.
ping不通，所以HTTP一定不可用。: Ping failed, therefore HTTP must be unavailable.
ICMP与TCP/HTTP可能受不同策略处理；该证据没有经过同一协议路径。: ICMP and TCP/HTTP may be handled by different policies, so this is not the same protocol path.
分别记录ICMP和目标协议的结果，不把其中一个替代另一个。: Record each protocol result separately rather than substituting one for another.
另一条记录显示TLS握手成功，HTTP返回403。现在可以确定哪一项？: Another record completes TLS and returns HTTP 403. Which conclusion is established?
DNS仍是首个失败点: DNS is still the first failure
已收到该请求的HTTP响应，不能再把它定位成未完成解析；还需确认缓存等实际路径。: Receiving this HTTP response does not support an unresolved-name diagnosis; record the actual path, including caches.
请求到达了一个HTTP处理节点，应核对该节点的拒绝依据: An HTTP handler responded; inspect its refusal and identity
403是当前处理节点拒绝请求的证据。下一步结合请求标识查身份/策略，不能仅凭40: A handler refused the request. Correlate the request with identity and policy evidence; 403 alone does not identify faulty code.
TLS和HTTP已有响应证据，和“完全没有监听”不一致。: The recorded TLS and HTTP exchanges contradict that claim.
为DNS超时但已知IP访问得到502的两条离线记录画路径，写出两处独立待查问题。: Map offline DNS timeout and a separate known-IP request returning 502; list independent investigations.
名称解析链待核；另一次访问已到网关但上游响应有问题。注明IP访问可能改变TLS名: Investigate name resolution separately from the gateway/upstream symptom. Note that IP access may alter TLS names or routing and is not an equivalent request.
每一项结论标出对应记录与阶段。: Tie each conclusion to its record and stage.
不从一次超时或状态码直接写出未经验证的根因。: Do not invent a root cause from one timeout or status code.
HTTPS保护哪一段，身份验证停在哪里: Which hop HTTPS protects and authenticates
TLS在两个端点之间保护传输并验证对端身份。浏览器看到的证书属于它协商TLS的端: TLS protects a connection between endpoints and authenticates peers. The browser checks the endpoint with which it negotiates TLS. Termination at a gateway creates a separate onward connection with its own transport and identity policy.
证书验证不是只看有没有证书：还要按客户端策略核对信任链、目标名称与有效性。机密性: Certificate validation involves the trust chain, intended name and validity under client policy. Transport confidentiality is separate from authorization: encrypting a request does not establish access to an order.
把两跳的保证分开写: Write separate guarantees for two hops
合成架构：浏览器以HTTPS访问shop.example.invalid，证书在: Synthetic architecture: browser HTTPS to shop.example.invalid terminates at gateway G; G uses HTTP to service S, which reads orders. Browser certificate validation succeeds.
第一条连接是浏览器↔G：校验通过支持浏览器连接到被信任的目标TLS身份，且该连接: For browser↔G, successful validation supports the intended trusted TLS identity and protection of that connection. Label this edge only.
G↔S是HTTP，不能继承第一跳的加密保证。记录它经过的网络与可接触这条链路的主: G↔S uses HTTP and does not inherit first-hop encryption. Identify its network and potential observers before choosing separate TLS or other approved protection.
在S的订单处理处仍要核对主体和订单所有权。即使把G↔S改成TLS，甲读取乙订单的: S must still validate the caller and order ownership. Encrypting G↔S would not automatically prevent one user reading another user’s order.
图上形成三条记录：第一跳TLS已校验、第二跳HTTP待评估、订单对象授权另行验证: The record distinguishes validated first-hop TLS, an onward HTTP hop to assess, and separately verified object authorization.
只要忽略证书错误后页面能打开，就算HTTPS正常。: If ignoring the certificate warning opens the page, HTTPS is healthy.
跳过验证恰好移除了需要确认的身份保证；连通性不能证明连接到正确身份。: Bypassing validation removes the identity guarantee under investigation. Connectivity does not establish the intended peer.
保留原校验错误，修复名称、信任链或证书配置后重新验证。: Keep the error and repair name, chain or certificate configuration before retesting.
浏览器校验证书通过，网关再用明文HTTP连应用。哪个陈述准确？: The browser validates the gateway certificate; the gateway uses HTTP onward. Which statement is accurate?
浏览器只能证明自己的TLS连接，下一跳是独立的。: The browser establishes properties of its own TLS connection, not the next hop.
第一跳受TLS保护，下一跳要另行分析: First-hop TLS is established; assess the next hop separately
这是按端点描述实际保证，既没有忽略成功证据，也没有扩大它。: This describes the established property without extending it beyond the endpoints.
TLS不检查业务中的用户与对象关系。: TLS does not validate application-level user–object permissions.
给“客户端→负载均衡→API→数据库”的合成链路标出每段是否加密、由谁验证谁，以: Annotate encryption, peer validation and missing evidence for a synthetic client→load balancer→API→database chain.
逐边写协议和终止点，未知标待核；另外列API对象授权与数据库权限，避免把传输图当: Record protocol and termination per edge, mark unknowns, and separately list API and database permissions.
每段保证对应实际端点，未知不补造。: Tie guarantees to endpoints and leave unknowns explicit.
区分传输身份、存储保护与业务授权。: Separate peer identity, storage protection and business authorization.
把授权写成可以逐项核对的范围: Turn authorization into an actionable scope
测试范围不是一个域名就够了。同一资产可能允许只读而不允许修改，也可能只允许合成账: A domain name is not a complete testing scope. The same asset may permit reading but not writes, and only synthetic accounts within a window. Asset, identity, action and time must all match; a discovered dependency does not inherit authorization.
停止条件是工作计划的一部分：当出现生产数据、外部系统或超出预期的影响时，先停下相: Stop conditions belong in the plan. Unexpected production data, external systems or impact require pausing the relevant action, preserving minimal records and contacting the scope owner. Approved work may continue without expanding access to investigate.
一条跳转为什么不能跟着测试: Why a redirect does not extend permission
合成任务仅允许周五14:00–15:00以账户T读取staging.exampl: Synthetic scope permits account T to read order lists on staging.example.invalid Friday 14:00–15:00, excluding writes and production. A link redirects to an external payment service.
记录资产=测试站、身份=T、动作=读取列表、时间=一小时。取消订单属于写操作，即: Record staging, T, list reads and the one-hour window. Cancelling an order is a write and remains excluded even if the UI exposes it.
支付服务是新的资产且没有单独授权。记录跳转目标与产生链接的页面即可，不向支付服务: The payment service is a new unapproved asset. Record the dependency without sending test payloads or attempting to use staging credentials there.
看到非合成个人数据、操作开始写入或时间到15:00时停止相关步骤，联系指定负责人: Stop relevant steps on real personal data, a write action or 15:00, and contact the owner. Continuing requires explicit updated scope, not a self-authored note.
输出是一张允许/排除表和停止联系人，而不是“全站安全测试”。本例只做离线范围判断: Deliver an allow/exclusion table and stop contact, not a claim of testing the whole site. This is an offline planning exercise.
技术可达性与被授予的操作权限是两件事。: Technical reachability and granted authority are different.
先与书面范围逐项匹配；缺少任一项就保持待确认。: Match the written scope; any missing condition remains unapproved.
范围只准读取测试订单，页面出现“批量删除”。应怎么处理？: The scope permits reading test orders and the UI exposes bulk delete. What should you do?
用一个订单试删除，影响小: Try deleting one order because impact is small
少量写入仍是被排除的动作，数量不创造授权。: A small write remains excluded; low volume does not grant authority.
先扩大到生产确认按钮是否相同: Check production to compare the button
生产资产明确不在范围内，比较目的也不改变边界。: Production remains outside scope regardless of the comparison purpose.
记录入口，不执行删除，向范围负责人核对: Record it without deleting and ask the scope owner
这样保留了发现，又没有把可见入口误当操作批准。: This preserves the observation without treating a visible control as permission.
写一张仅供本机演练的资产/身份/动作/时间/停止条件表，包含一个明确排除的第三方: Write an offline scope table with asset, identity, action, window and stops, including an excluded third-party dependency.
测试门户、合成用户T、只读、约定窗口；排除生产和外部支付。出现真实数据或需要写入: Specify staging, synthetic T, read-only actions and a window; exclude production and external payment, with data/write stop rules.
允许与排除项能逐个判定，而不是“适当测试”。: Make permission decidable rather than saying test appropriately.
停止后的联系人及再次开始条件明确。: State the contact and conditions for resuming.
退出之后，旧会话为什么还要验证: Why an old session must fail after logout
认证让服务确认当前身份；会话把该结果连接到后续请求。浏览器携带的Cookie只是: Authentication establishes identity; a session carries that result into later requests. A cookie is only a credential carrier. The server must still check existence, expiry and revocation, including copies held in other windows.
空闲超时衡量多久没有活动，总超时限制会话整体寿命，主动注销则是明确撤销。密码重置: Idle expiry, absolute lifetime and explicit logout address different conditions. Password recovery and privilege changes need declared session policy. Avoid a universal timeout and do not put raw session tokens in logs.
合成账号A在窗口W1、W2使用同一会话S。W1发出退出请求。教学契约要求退出立即: Synthetic account A uses session S in W1 and W2. W1 logs out. The teaching contract requires immediate revocation of S and reauthentication of old requests.
退出前W2读取自己的资料成功，证明S原来可用。记录请求编号与成功状态，不把S的实: W2 reads its own profile before logout, establishing that S worked. Record request identity and status without exposing the credential.
W1退出后，服务把S标为无效或删除其有效记录。前端清理本窗口凭据是体验步骤，不能: Logout invalidates S in server-side session state. Clearing the current browser is useful but does not replace revocation.
W2再携旧S请求应得到需重新认证的结果，资料正文不得返回。若页面按钮隐藏但接口仍: W2 reuses old S and must receive a reauthentication response without profile data. Hiding buttons while the API still returns data fails this control.
报告包括退出前成功、退出回执、退出后旧会话被拒三项，并注明测试契约；它只验证注销: Record pre-logout success, logout receipt and rejection of the old session under the declared contract; this does not establish object authorization.
退出后看不到头像，因此会话一定失效。: The avatar vanished, so the session is invalid.
头像可能只是本地状态，未观察服务端是否继续接收旧凭据。: An avatar can be local state and says nothing about server acceptance.
在合成环境核对旧会话访问结果与响应正文。: Verify the old synthetic session and response body.
产品约定退出撤销S；另一个窗口用S仍可读到资料。哪个结论正确？: Policy says logout revokes S, but another window still reads data using S. What follows?
注销控制未达到该契约，需要查服务端撤销: Logout fails the contract; inspect server revocation
旧S仍被接受是直接的反例，不能由前端退出画面抵消。: Acceptance of old S is a direct counterexample despite the logged-out UI.
只要关掉另一窗口就通过: Closing the other window makes the test pass
这回避了旧凭据是否有效的问题。: Closing the window avoids rather than verifies the requirement.
登录流程也必然全部无效: Every part of login is necessarily broken
证据定位到注销撤销，不足以推翻所有认证功能。: Evidence concerns logout revocation, not every authentication function.
为合成用户的密码重置写三条会话检查，先明确“是否撤销其他设备”的产品策略。: Define a password-reset policy for synthetic sessions and write three checks, including other devices.
记录重置前会话、重置动作、旧设备是否按政策失效；新登录应正常。未知政策先待核，不: Record old sessions, reset, expected old-device behavior and a normal new login; do not invent an undeclared policy.
预期来自明确生命周期策略。: Derive expectations from an explicit lifecycle policy.
报告不泄漏会话秘密且包含允许/拒绝对照。: Avoid credential disclosure and include success/rejection controls.
一个权限判断要同时回答谁、做什么、对哪个对象: Authorization binds actor, action and resource
登录只证明身份，授权才决定该身份能对具体资源做什么。一个可核对的判断写成“主体A: Login establishes identity; authorization decides an action on a particular resource. Actor A, read, order X, owned by A is more precise than a generic user order permission. Equal roles can have different object scopes.
服务必须对每次相关请求验证关系，不能仅依赖页面隐藏按钮、难猜的编号或客户端传来的: Enforce relationships on relevant requests rather than hiding controls, guessing-resistant IDs or client-supplied owner_id. Grant only necessary actions and deny undeclared permissions, including batch, export and creation paths.
合成订单X属于A，Y属于B。所有者能读取和取消自己的未发货订单；客服C只能读取，: Synthetic X belongs to A and Y to B. Owners may read and cancel their own unshipped orders. Support C may read but not cancel. Identity comes from the server session.
A读取X应允许，证明正常入口没有被全关；记录对象X和返回结果。测试拒绝路径前先保: A reading X should succeed, establishing a working legitimate path before rejection cases.
改变对象而不是身份: Change the resource, not the identity
仍用A的会话，把对象改成Y。服务按实际订单归属拒绝，不能读取客户端传入的“own: With A’s session, request Y. Check stored ownership, reject the request and return no Y body; a supplied owner=A must not grant access.
C读取Y允许，C取消Y拒绝且订单状态不变。这证明“能看”不等于“能改”，同时覆盖: C reading Y is allowed, but cancelling Y is rejected and its state stays unchanged. Read permission is not write permission.
权限表应至少列A读X允许、A读Y拒绝、C读Y允许、C取消Y拒绝，并记录拒绝后的状: The table records A→read X allow, A→read Y deny, C→read Y allow and C→cancel Y deny, with response/state evidence.
订单号换成随机长串，就不需要对象检查。: Random long IDs remove the need for object checks.
泄漏、分享链接或其他接口仍可能暴露编号；不可猜性不授予访问权限。: IDs may leak through links or APIs; unpredictability does not confer permission.
每个读写入口都以可信主体与真实对象关系判定。: Apply trusted actor–resource checks at each entry point.
客服可以读取订单但不能修改。读取成功之后，应该再验证哪条？: Support can read but not modify orders. After a successful read, what else must be checked?
同一客服能否取消订单且状态不变: Whether cancellation is denied and the order stays unchanged
应期待取消被拒并检查业务状态，覆盖动作权限而非只看界面。: Expect cancellation rejection and unchanged state, covering action authorization rather than UI appearance.
客服能猜出多少订单号: How many order IDs support can guess
猜测难度不能代替动作权限验证，也不需要扩大到真实资产测试。: Guessing difficulty does not establish action authorization or justify probing real assets.
页面按钮是否足够隐蔽: Whether the button is sufficiently hidden
按钮不是服务端安全边界。: A hidden control is not the server-side boundary.
为“项目成员可读文档、仅文档创建者可删除、离组后失去访问”写主体/动作/对象矩阵: Build an actor/action/resource matrix for members reading documents, creators deleting them and former members losing access.
包含成员读本组、非成员读本组、非创建者删、创建者删、离组后再读；拒绝时正文不泄漏: Include member/non-member reads, non-creator/creator deletes and post-removal access, with non-disclosure and unchanged-state rejection checks.
至少一个允许样本与两个不同拒绝原因。: Include an allowed case and two distinct denial causes.
身份从可信会话取得，不能由请求正文冒充。: Take identity from a trusted session, not the request body.
密钥泄漏后，轮换为什么不等于删文件: Why deleting a file does not revoke a leaked secret
密钥授予能力，知道它的人可能继续调用服务。源码、镜像、日志和工单会形成副本，删除: A secret grants capability. Copies in source, images, logs or tickets survive deletion of the current file. Response must both stop acceptance of the compromised credential and migrate approved consumers.
轮换顺序依紧急程度与系统支持决定。计划轮换可先发新值、迁移使用方再撤旧值；确认泄: Sequence depends on urgency and system support. Planned rotation may introduce a new value, migrate consumers then revoke the old one; compromise may require immediate revocation despite disruption. Encryption keys may also protect historical reads.
迁移两个受控使用方并验证旧值失效: Migrate two controlled consumers and reject the old value
合成测试服务有使用方A/B，共用已泄漏凭据K。系统支持临时并存K/L，负责人批准: Synthetic consumers A/B share compromised K. The system supports temporary K/L overlap and the owner approves migration followed by revocation at 10:20. This exercise policy is not a universal delay for compromises.
登记A、B以及它们可做的动作。创建权限不大于K的L，放入受控秘密存储；报告只写凭: List A/B and their permitted actions. Create L with no broader permissions and store it securely; report identifiers, not secret values.
A改用L后验证允许动作成功、越权动作仍拒绝；再迁移B。完成记录为A=L、B=L，: Move A to L, verify legitimate actions and continued denial of excess permissions, then move B. Record actual activation rather than mere notification.
按批准窗口撤K；以合成旧K尝试教学服务的受控请求应拒绝，L正常。若K仍成功，轮换: Revoke K at the approved point. The controlled synthetic K request must fail while L works. Acceptance of K means rotation is incomplete despite its absence from current files.
交付包含A/B迁移回执、K撤销时点、旧值拒绝/新值成功对照、尚待处理副本位置；没: Deliver migration receipts, K’s revocation time, old-rejected/new-accepted evidence and remaining copy locations without exposing values.
把泄漏工单删除，再重启服务就安全了。: Delete the leaked ticket and restart the service.
服务或攻击者可能持有旧值，工单删除没有改变验证端的接受规则。: Consumers or attackers may retain K; deletion does not change credential acceptance.
按事件策略轮换/撤销并核对旧值确实失效。: Rotate or revoke under incident policy and verify rejection of the old credential.
A/B均已改用L，但测试服务仍接受K。当前状态是？: A/B use L, but the test service still accepts K. What is the state?
只验证了迁移，没有验证撤销目标。: Migration is established, but revocation is not.
仍需完成旧值撤销与拒绝验证: Old-value revocation and rejection are incomplete
泄漏凭据仍可用是直接风险，须依策略处理并保留证据。: The compromised credential still works; resolve this under the declared policy and retain evidence.
新值长度不会让K自动失效。: Changing L’s length does not invalidate K.
为一个有在线服务和定时任务的合成密钥写轮换记录，列出立即撤销与平滑迁移两种策略的: Plan rotation for a synthetic secret used by an online service and scheduled job; compare immediate revocation with staged migration.
分别确认使用方、生效证据、撤销时点、故障恢复与旧值拒绝。若是数据加密密钥，另列历: Record consumers, activation, revocation, recovery and old-value rejection; identify historical decryption dependencies for encryption keys.
策略依据泄漏影响和系统能力，而非固定机械顺序。: Base sequencing on impact and system capabilities.
不在作答中粘贴真实秘密。: Do not paste real secrets into the artifact.
事件时间是动作发生的时点，采集时间是日志到达的时点，两者可能不同。排序前先统一时: Event time is when an action happened; collection time is when it arrived. Normalize zones while retaining originals, or late delivery and display times can create a false sequence.
关联需要稳定标识及其语义。相同会话可支持会话级关联，相同IP却可能只是共享出口；: Stable IDs support correlation at their declared scope. A shared IP can be common egress, and nearby times do not establish one person. Missing logs may reflect sampling, collection failure or absent fields.
三条记录中哪两条能连接: Which two records can be linked?
合成E1：09:15+08:00登录，session=S7；E2：01:16Z读: Synthetic E1 logs in at 09:15+08:00 with S7; E2 reads at 01:16Z with S7; E3 exports at 01:16Z with only a shared IP. E1/E2 share an authentication system.
E1减去8小时为01:15Z，E2保持01:16Z，相隔1分钟。表中并列原时间、: E1 becomes 01:15Z and E2 remains 01:16Z, one minute later. Keep originals, UTC and IDs together for reproducibility.
E1/E2共享同一系统的S7，支持同会话时间线，但是否异常仍需核对主体与订单归属: Shared S7 supports one session timeline, not an attack conclusion. Inspect actor and order ownership separately.
E3不能仅凭IP并入S7，标为待关联；下一证据是导出请求ID或会话字段，并检查采: Keep E3 unlinked; seek an export request/session ID and inspect whether collection omitted the field.
结果为01:15Z登录→01:16Z读取；E3待关联。结论均有原记录和时间换算，: Supported sequence: login at 01:15Z then read at 01:16Z, with E3 unlinked and provenance retained.
同一分钟、同一IP就属于同一用户。: Same minute and IP mean the same user.
代理与共享出口可让多人同时使用一个IP。: Proxies and shared egress reuse IPs across people.
按可靠标识和上下文关联，证据不足保持待查。: Use stable IDs and context; leave unsupported links open.
E1=10:00+08:00，E2=02:02Z，共享请求Q。规范顺序是？: E1 is 10:00+08:00 and E2 is 02:02Z, sharing Q. Which order is correct?
E2比E1早近8小时: E2 is almost eight hours earlier
直接比较了两个时区的显示值；E1应换为02:00Z。: This compares displays without normalization; E1 is 02:00Z.
E1在02:00Z，E2晚2分钟: E1 is 02:00Z; E2 is two minutes later
换算后可建立时序，但仍保留原时区和时间精度。: This supports the time order while retaining zones and precision.
标识支持关联，不自动证明一个动作导致另一个。: An ID supports correlation, not complete causality.
整理两种时区和一条只有IP的合成日志，分已关联/待关联，并查一次采集缺口。: Normalize two zones and classify synthetic logs as linked/unlinked, including a collection-gap check.
保留原时间、UTC、ID及会话来源；缺标识的事件待查，检查采集字段或送达延迟。: Keep source time, UTC, IDs and session origin; inspect omitted fields and delivery delays.
时间换算可复算，关联不扩大。: Conversions are reproducible and links are not overstated.
记录未知与采集限制，不保存令牌正文。: State unknowns and collection limits without token values.
从一条告警建立可验证的解释: Turn an alert into testable explanations
告警说明检测条件被触发，不等于已经证明攻击。分诊先确认实际事件、受影响资产和证据: An alert establishes a triggered rule, not an attack. Validate events, affected assets and evidence before comparing explanations. Confidence concerns reliability of the conclusion; impact concerns consequences.
有用的假设能被证据支持或推翻。例如维护重试应对应获准身份、目标和时间；只有日历重: A useful hypothesis names supporting and refuting evidence. Maintenance retry should match approved identity, target and time. Preserve relevant evidence without expanding authorization.
20次失败后成功，下一步查什么: Investigate twenty failures followed by success
合成U在02:00–02:04失败20次，02:05成功，IP多人共享。维护单M: Synthetic U fails twenty times then succeeds at 02:05 from shared egress. Maintenance M permits S on a different host at 02:00.
事实是U的失败/成功序列与共享IP；攻击成功和正常维护都只是解释。先核认证结果、: Facts are U’s sequence and the shared IP. Attack and maintenance remain hypotheses; verify event fields first.
M使用S且目标不同，不能解释U的访问。记录两项不匹配，不因时间重合就关闭告警。: S and its target differ from U’s event; record both mismatches rather than closing on time overlap.
在授权日志中查成功会话的对象、动作及预期业务，向责任人核对。若可能影响关键资产，: Inspect authorized logs for objects, actions and expected business use. Escalate potential critical impact under policy without inventing a cause.
记录两个假设、支持/反证、影响与下一证据。维护解释不足，但还不能由此直接证明攻击: Record hypotheses, evidence, impact and next evidence. Insufficient maintenance evidence does not prove an attack.
失败次数多就写攻击成功。: Many failures prove a successful attack.
计数没有解释成功身份、后续动作或业务背景。: The count does not explain identity, subsequent actions or business context.
写可检验假设，按潜在影响安排跟进。: State testable hypotheses and prioritize by potential impact.
告警与维护时间重合，但身份和目标不同。应怎样判断？: The alert overlaps maintenance, but identity and target differ. What follows?
忽略了身份和资产不匹配。: This ignores mismatched identity and asset.
排除一种解释不等于证明另一种。: Refuting one explanation does not establish another.
维护解释不足，继续查成功会话动作: Maintenance is insufficient; inspect subsequent session actions
准确保留证据强度并给出可操作的下一核对。: This preserves evidence strength and defines a next check.
给合成异常导出写两种解释，每种附反证和获准可取的下一证据。: Give two explanations for a synthetic unusual export, with counterevidence and an authorized follow-up.
比较获批月报与未授权读取，核对申请、主体、对象和数量；分别写影响、置信度与升级条: Compare approved reporting with unauthorized access using approval, actor, objects and volume, with separate impact/confidence/escalation.
不把单一IP或时间当身份和因果。: Do not treat IP or time alone as identity or cause.
让下一位接手者知道事实、影响和下一步: Write a handoff the receiver can act on
交接不是转发聊天记录。接手者需要发生时间、当前影响、支撑事实的证据、已做动作及批: A handoff identifies time, impact, evidence, actions and authority rather than forwarding chat. Keep unknown causes and unverified assets explicit.
下一步包含负责人、目标与再次更新时间。敏感证据留在有访问控制的位置，摘要只给定位: Next steps need an owner, purpose and update time. Keep sensitive evidence access-controlled. Operational handoff need not wait for the later root-cause review.
两台主机的状态怎样交接: Hand off two hosts without overstating evidence
合成A9：02:00Z订单查询部分超时；L17确认H1异常，H2未核；R在02:: Synthetic A9 starts at 02:00Z with partial order-query timeouts. L17 confirms H1, H2 is unverified, R authorizes isolation at 02:10Z with C4, and impact continues.
写A9、订单查询部分失败、02:00Z起；H1已确认→L17，H2待核。不写两台: State incident, partial impact and time; link H1 to L17 and leave H2 unverified rather than inventing compromise or safety.
列隔离对象、R批准、时点与C4；同时报告订单查询影响仍在。动作成功不能代替业务路: Record isolation, approval, time and C4 alongside continuing user impact. Action success does not establish recovery.
N在02:25Z前查H2同窗记录及订单路径，02:30Z更新影响。根因保留未知，: N checks H2 and the order path by 02:25Z and updates impact at 02:30Z. Retain unknown cause and controlled evidence links.
接手记录包含事件/影响、确认与待核资产、L17/C4、批准动作、N及下一更新时间: The receiver gets incident, impact, asset confidence, L17/C4, approved action, N and the next update time.
隔离回执成功，所以事件已恢复。: Isolation succeeded, so the incident recovered.
回执只验证隔离，不验证用户查询。: The receipt verifies isolation, not user queries.
分别报告动作结果和业务恢复证据。: Report action results separately from recovery evidence.
H1已证实异常，H2没有记录。准确的交接是？: H1 is confirmed abnormal and H2 lacks evidence. Which handoff is accurate?
H1确认、H2待核，附证据和下一负责人: H1 confirmed, H2 unverified, with evidence and owner
证据强度和接手动作均可核对。: This preserves evidence strength and executable follow-up.
接手者仍无法判断用户影响与恢复。: The receiver still lacks impact and recovery criteria.
写一页合成下载失败交接，分事实/假设/未知并指定更新时间。: Write a one-page synthetic download-failure handoff with facts, hypotheses, unknowns and an update time.
按事件ID、时间、用户范围、证据、批准动作、下一负责人和恢复检查组织；未知原因保: Include incident, time, users, evidence, approved actions, owner and recovery checks, with unknown cause explicit.
接手者不读完整聊天也能继续。: The receiver can continue without the whole chat.
证据与权限分清，正文不含秘密。: Separate evidence and authority; omit secrets.
给上传服务画一张能指导验证的威胁模型: Build a threat model that guides upload-service tests
资产是要保护的东西，例如其他用户的文件、文件所有权记录和可用存储容量。数据流图描: Assets include other users’ files, ownership records and capacity. Data flows show who passes which data to each process; trust boundaries mark changes in control or authorization. Components are only a starting point: examine controlled inputs and the asset harmed at each boundary.
把威胁写成可观察的失败情境，再匹配控制与验证。“输入有风险”无法验收；“A修改文: Write observable failure scenarios and map controls and tests to them. Input is risky is too vague; A changes an ID and receives B’s file identifies actor, action, resource and impact. A proposed control is verified only for the conditions actually tested.
上传、保存、下载：建立资产—威胁—控制关系: Upload, storage and download: connect assets, threats and controls
合成服务：已登录A提交文件名report.pdf、内容及owner_id给上传A: Synthetic service: authenticated A submits report.pdf, bytes and owner_id. An upload API writes private storage and ownership metadata; a download API retrieves by ID. B owns F2. This is an offline/local exercise without real files or accounts.
画浏览器→上传API→存储/元数据，以及浏览器→下载API→存储。资产列B的F2: Draw browser→upload API→storage/metadata and browser→download API→storage. Protect F2 content, ownership and capacity. Browser→API changes input control; API→storage uses service credentials with a different privilege boundary.
主体不能由表单自报: Do not trust the form to select identity
A能改owner_id，所以从可信会话确定主体A，不把文件写到表单声称的B名下。: A can alter owner_id. Use trusted session identity, not a supplied owner, and test that owner_id=B is rejected or cannot change ownership from A.
名称、内容和存储分开控制: Control names, content and storage separately
文件名只作显示元数据，不直接成为存储路径；服务生成受控对象键、限制大小/类型、保: Treat names as display metadata, generate controlled keys, bound size/type and keep storage private. These separately address path choice, capacity and direct access. Extension checks and scanning do not prove universally safe content.
上传检查保护不了另一个入口。A请求B的F2时按真实元数据拒绝且不返回正文；A请求: The upload check does not secure a separate download. Deny A→F2 without content while allowing A→F1. Random IDs do not replace actor–action–resource authorization.
每行写威胁→执行位置→预期→证据：伪造归属在上传API，跨用户读取在下载API，: Record threat, enforcement point, expectation and evidence: forged owner at upload, cross-user access at download and size bounds at receipt. Untested controls remain proposals, not proven security.
输出两条数据流、三类资产和至少三条控制映射。A读F1允许、A读F2拒绝且无正文，: Deliver flows, assets and control mappings. A→F1 allowed and A→F2 denied without content are the minimum access controls here, not proof of all file security.
文件扩展名通过校验，所以A不能读取B的文件。: Validated extensions mean A cannot read B’s file.
扩展名处理上传内容，不检查下载时主体与文件归属。: An extension check does not validate ownership on download.
下载逐请求核对可信主体与真实归属，并保留本人允许、他人拒绝的对照。: Check trusted identity and ownership on downloads, with own-file success and other-user denial.
上传名称和大小均通过，A把下载ID改成B的F2。哪项直接保护B？: Name and size checks pass; A requests B’s F2. Which control directly protects B?
扩展名不回答谁有权读取对象。: Extensions do not decide who may read an object.
下载接口核对可信身份与F2归属，拒绝越权且不回正文: The download API verifies identity/ownership and denies without content
绑定了A、读取动作和F2对象；拒绝时还要观察正文没有泄漏。: This binds actor, action and resource, with non-disclosure evidence.
编号可能从分享或其他接口得到，长度不创造授权。: IDs may be disclosed elsewhere; length does not confer permission.
给合成头像服务画数据流，补“只准本人替换/删除头像”的威胁与检查。: Model a synthetic avatar service and test owner-only replacement/deletion.
列主体、元数据、存储；本人替换允许，A替换/删除B头像拒绝且B内容不变；文件限制: List actor, metadata and storage; allow own replacement, deny edits/deletion of B’s avatar and verify unchanged bytes, separately from file restrictions.
每条威胁有资产、边界和控制执行位置。: Each threat has an asset, boundary and enforcement point.
有允许/拒绝对照，未执行的控制保持待验证。: Include allow/deny controls and label unexecuted controls as proposed.
查询结构与用户值需要两种不同的处理: Query structure and supplied values need different treatment
输入校验约束类型、长度和业务范围，例如页码只能是约定范围的整数；参数化查询则把用: Validation checks type, length and business ranges. Parameterization keeps values out of SQL structure. Validated data still needs structural separation, and bound parameters still need business validation.
列名、表名和排序方向通常不能当普通值参数绑定。让客户端的amount映射到开发者: Identifiers and sort directions generally require fixed developer mappings. Map amount to an approved column, reject unknown keys and bind legitimate names such as O’Neil without stripping characters.
带引号姓名与排序选项的两条处理线: Handle a quoted name and sort options separately
合成输入name=O’Neil，sort=amount，direction=de: Synthetic name=O’Neil, sort=amount and direction=desc. Only date/amount and asc/desc are permitted. Pseudocode is driver-neutral; check actual placeholder syntax.
amount映射order_amount，desc映射固定DESC；date映射: Map amount to order_amount, desc to fixed DESC and date to order_date. Reject unknown identifiers instead of concatenating them.
查询形状为WHERE customer_name=参数 ORDER BY ord: Use a fixed WHERE customer_name=parameter ORDER BY order_amount DESC shape, binding the full name as data.
合法姓名应保留原字符，合法排序正常，未知sort被拒。核对真实查询调用是否绑定，: Verify preserved names, valid sorting and rejection of unknown sort keys; inspect binding in the actual query call.
结构由固定映射产生，普通值使用绑定，各自还保留相应的业务校验。: Structure comes from fixed mappings; ordinary values use bindings, with business checks retained.
删掉姓名所有引号即可防注入。: Removing quotes from names prevents injection.
这损坏合法输入且没有证明查询结构隔离。: It corrupts valid input without establishing structural separation.
保留合法值并绑定；结构仅来自允许映射。: Preserve valid values and bind them; constrain structure to approved mappings.
sort改成未定义other时应该怎样做？: What should happen for undefined sort=other?
作为值绑定就能变成列名: Bind it as a value to become a column
普通值参数不通用地替换列标识符。: Ordinary value placeholders do not generally substitute identifiers.
拒绝未知键，仅使用受控列映射: Reject it and use only controlled identifier mappings
非法结构不进入查询，合法选项仍可用。: Unknown structure cannot enter the query; valid choices remain supported.
直接拼接，因为页面是下拉框: Concatenate it because the UI is a dropdown
写一个按日期或总额排序的合成搜索处理，再测含引号姓名与未知排序。: Write synthetic date/amount search handling and test a quoted name and unknown sort.
name绑定，sort/direction固定映射；未知键拒绝。注明驱动占位语法: Bind name, map structural choices, reject unknowns and identify driver syntax, retaining valid-case results.
解释值与标识符为何分开。: Explain why data and identifiers differ.
有合法成功与非法结构拒绝两种证据。: Include valid success and invalid-structure rejection.
把控制要求变成可重复的验证: Turn a control into repeatable verification
控制要求需要身份、动作、对象、前置状态和可观察预期。“权限修复了”无法测试；“A: A testable control names identity, action, object, preconditions and observable expectations. A cannot edit B’s note is testable; permissions fixed is not. Fix version and starting data.
拒绝响应还不够，要检查正文泄漏和副作用。也要保留正常允许路径：若修复把所有请求都: Rejection alone is insufficient: inspect disclosure and side effects, and preserve legitimate success. Denying everyone breaks the product. A pass covers documented versions and conditions only.
合成X属于A且备注old；Y属于B且备注keep。v2声称只有所有者可改，每次测: Synthetic X belongs to A with old; Y belongs to B with keep. Version v2 claims owner-only edits. Reset starting data between cases.
A把X改为new应成功，再读X为new，证明正常认证、写入与持久化仍可用。: A edits X to new and reads back new, establishing legitimate authentication, writing and persistence.
A改Y应拒绝；由获准身份读回Y应仍为keep，以抓住“返回拒绝但已经写入”的实现: Deny A editing Y and verify authorized readback remains keep, catching denial after a write.
记录v2、身份、对象、请求/响应及读回值。修复后重跑同一对照，不用勾选已修复代替: Record version, actors, resources, responses and readback; rerun the same controls after repair.
最小证据是一条本人成功、一条他人拒绝且无副作用，附版本与前置条件；它不是全站认证: Minimum evidence is own-object success and other-object denial without effects, with version and preconditions.
代码可能先写再拒绝，状态码没有覆盖存储结果。: Code might write before denying; the status does not establish stored state.
在合成环境读回并检查副作用。: Read back the controlled synthetic state.
A改B的Y返回拒绝，但keep变为new，应怎样记录？: A editing B’s Y is denied, but keep becomes new. What is the result?
业务状态已变化，是实际控制反例。: Changed business state is a substantive counterexample.
拒绝与无副作用必须同时满足。: Denial and absence of unauthorized effects must both hold.
为离组成员不能下载文档设计允许、拒绝和泄漏检查。: Test former-member document access with allow, deny and disclosure checks.
现成员下载允许；离组后旧身份拒绝且无正文；其他获准成员仍可用。记录成员状态和策略: Allow current members, deny the revoked member without bytes and retain other approved access, with membership/version evidence.
每条预期对应控制声明。: Map each expectation to the control.
分别观察拒绝、无泄漏/副作用、正常回归。: Observe denial, non-disclosure/effects and normal regression separately.
用服务身份解释文件为什么读不到: Explain file access under the service identity
进程以具体用户及组运行，权限检查沿整条路径发生。读取已知文件不仅需要文件读权限，: Processes run under a user and groups. Reading a known file needs file read permission and parent-directory traversal. Directory read permits listing; directory execute permits lookup. Administrator success does not establish service access.
最小权限从任务反推：读日志、写状态和执行程序是不同能力。不要用任意人可写或管理员: Derive minimum permissions from reads, writes and execution. Avoid world-write and administrator shortcuts. ACLs, container mappings and mandatory controls may further restrict access; verify with the real identity in a controlled environment.
纸面Linux示例：svc属于reports组，父级允许遍历。reports目录: Paper Linux example: svc belongs to reports; ancestors are traversable. The reports directory grants group listing but no traversal; data.csv grants group read. Only reading the known file is required.
svc按reports组核对，不使用管理员结果。文件读权限成立，但目录没有查找已: Check reports permissions for svc, not administrator results. File read is available but directory traversal is missing.
失败发生在目录查找阶段，因此修改文件读权限没有针对原因。目录列名与经过目录是不同: The failure is directory lookup; changing file read permission does not address it. Listing and traversal differ.
写最小修订与复验: Specify a minimal change and recheck
只为指定组补充需要的遍历，文件仍只读；以svc验证已知文件可读、写入与无关目录仍: Grant only necessary traversal to the designated group and keep the file read-only. Verify allowed read and denied writes/unrelated paths; inspect ACLs or mappings if needed. No real system is modified.
原因是目录缺遍历而非文件缺读取；交付应解释身份、路径、最小能力以及允许/拒绝对照: The missing capability is directory traversal, not file reading; document identity, path, minimal permission and controls.
开放所有人读写或改用root就算修复。: World-write or root counts as a repair.
扩大了无关能力，也遮住了失败原因。: That expands privileges and hides the cause.
针对实际身份补最小能力并复核拒绝路径。: Change only required capabilities and verify denial boundaries.
svc能读文件，但父目录对它没有遍历权限。能直接读取该路径吗？: svc can read the file but cannot traverse a parent. Can it read that path?
文件读不能替代每级目录的遍历权限。: File read cannot replace parent traversal.
管理员不代表服务的实际权限。: Administrator permissions do not represent the service.
为只读应用日志、只写自身状态的合成采集器列身份和允许/拒绝检查。: Plan identity and allow/deny checks for a synthetic log collector.
逐层核对读日志与写状态路径；拒绝写日志、读其他服务秘密及写系统配置，说明ACL或: Check log-read and state-write paths, deny unrelated writes/secrets and note ACL/container constraints.
按实际身份逐层解释。: Explain each path under the actual identity.
网关、应用或代理都可能产生HTTP状态码。状态描述响应语义，不提供完整根因。把请: Gateways, applications and proxies can emit statuses. A status describes a response, not a complete cause. Align request IDs, time, responder and hop logs.
先找最早失败边界：解析、连接、TLS还是HTTP/业务。一次健康检查只覆盖被定义: Locate the earliest failed stage: resolution, connection, TLS or HTTP/business. A health check covers its defined path, not authentication, storage or dependencies. Recheck critical user paths after changes.
合成Q8：客户端收到502；网关Q8日志为连接上游8080被拒；应用无Q8；服务: Offline Q8 gets 502; the gateway logs refusal on upstream 8080, the app has no Q8, and the service inventory specifies 8081.
客户端到网关已有响应，网关到上游连接被拒。不能说是应用业务代码主动返回502。: The gateway responded, but its upstream connection failed. This does not establish an application-generated 502.
8080与8081不一致，提出目标端口不匹配；仍要核当时配置和获准监听记录，当前: The mismatch suggests wrong routing, but verify historical configuration and listener evidence rather than assuming the inventory is current.
批准修订后核对实际目标、应用请求ID和正常订单读取。连接成功只是中间证据，业务结: After approved correction, verify actual target, application request and order read. Connectivity alone does not establish that path’s recovery.
报告网关到上游连接失败、端口差异待核、监听/配置/业务三项证据，不直接修改无关查: Report the failed hop, port hypothesis and listener/configuration/business evidence rather than changing unrelated queries.
请求可能没到业务处理。: The request may not have reached business processing.
先定位返回节点与首个失败阶段。: Find the responder and earliest failure first.
TLS完成后403，与TCP超时的下一步相同吗？: Does HTTP 403 after TLS need the same next check as a TCP timeout?
403查处理节点拒绝依据，超时先查连接路径: Inspect refusal for 403 and connection evidence for timeout
按实际停止阶段选择证据，不合并成未经验证的根因。: Choose evidence by stage without inventing a shared cause.
403说明全部应用不可用: 403 proves the entire application is unavailable
只能说明当前请求的拒绝，不能覆盖所有路径。: It establishes refusal of this request, not every path.
整理一条403和一条连接超时的合成记录，各写下一证据和不能声称的结论。: Analyze synthetic 403 and timeout records with next evidence and unsupported claims.
403查身份/策略/返回节点；超时查监听与路径，均保留ID和时间窗。: Check identity/policy/responder for 403 and listener/path for timeout, retaining IDs and windows.
把相关指标变成可检验的故障假设: Turn correlated metrics into testable hypotheses
CPU、流量、延迟和错误描述不同现象。CPU升高可能是流量增加的结果，时间靠前也: CPU, traffic, latency and errors describe different phenomena. CPU can be a consequence; temporal order is not causality. Start with user-visible impact and discriminating evidence.
平均值会隐藏慢请求，服务总计会隐藏特定版本。对照要同窗、同业务分组，记录采样与聚: Means hide slow subsets and totals hide versions. Align windows and cohorts, document sampling and compare refutable explanations rather than declaring insufficient CPU.
发布、流量和CPU一起变化: Release, traffic and CPU change together
合成：12:00发布；12:02 p95从200到900ms、错误1%到6%；1: Synthetic release at 12:00; p95 rises 200→900ms and errors 1→6% at 12:02; traffic doubles and CPU reaches 80% at 12:04.
错误和尾延迟先异常，报告受影响路径与时间。CPU较晚，只作为线索。: Errors and tail latency degraded first; record affected paths and time, keeping CPU as a clue.
新版本回归需候选/稳定对照；流量或容量变化需请求类型、队列和下游拆分。不能由相关: A regression needs version comparison; capacity/workload changes need request-type, queue and dependency evidence. Correlation does not select a cause.
仅候选同负载恶化支持回归；所有版本随共享依赖排队支持共同瓶颈。两者可以同时存在，: Candidate-only degradation supports regression; cross-version queuing supports a shared bottleneck. Both may coexist.
输出时间线、影响、假设与下一对照，不把扩容写成已证实恢复方法。: Deliver timeline, impact, hypotheses and next controls, not a guaranteed scaling remedy.
CPU高就是根因，扩容必恢复。: High CPU is the cause; scaling guarantees recovery.
共享数据库或下游瓶颈可能仍在。: A shared database or downstream bottleneck may remain.
按版本、业务与依赖证据区分。: Compare version, workload and dependency evidence.
p95升高但平均值稳定，准确解释是？: p95 rises with a stable mean. Which interpretation fits?
均值可能稀释慢请求。: The mean can dilute a slow subset.
尾延迟没有独立定位资源根因。: Tail latency alone does not locate a resource cause.
慢请求子集恶化，继续按路径或人群拆分: A slow subset degraded; split by path or cohort
保留体验变化，同时不扩大根因判断。: This preserves observed impact without inventing its cause.
为流量不变但错误升高写两个解释和下一证据。: Explain rising errors with stable traffic using two hypotheses and follow-ups.
比较版本缺陷与下游失败，查版本分组、依赖日志，并核错误分母与窗口。: Compare version defects and dependency failure with version splits, logs and aligned denominators/windows.
不把相关性当因果，不漏用户影响。: Separate correlation and cause while retaining impact.
从构建材料到可追溯的运行镜像: From build inputs to a traceable runtime image
镜像是分层文件系统与运行配置的组合，容器是它启动后的进程。构建时把文件写入一层，: An image combines filesystem layers with runtime configuration; a container is a running instance. Deleting a file in a later layer does not remove the earlier layer. Never copy credentials and then clean them up; use build-secret mounts for temporary build credentials and deployment-managed runtime secrets.
多阶段构建把编译工具与运行产物分开，但不自动证明安全。运行阶段仍需匹配依赖、非特: Multi-stage builds separate build tools from runtime artifacts but do not establish safety by themselves. Check runtime dependencies, identity and startup behavior. Tags can move; digests identify image content. Record the actual digest for audit and rollback, rather than only latest. This is a read-only example, not a build or release.
同一份应用怎样避免把开发材料带到运行环境: Keep development materials out of the runtime image
合成目录含src、依赖锁文件、.env和编译器缓存。应用运行只需可执行产物app: A synthetic directory contains src, a dependency lockfile, .env and compiler cache. Runtime requires only app and its confirmed dependencies. The current proposal copies everything into the runtime image, deletes .env later, and publishes latest.
src和锁文件供构建使用；编译器缓存不属于交付物；.env中的凭据不进入构建上下: Source and lockfile support the build; compiler cache is not a deliverable. Keep .env credentials out of the build context. The runtime allowlist is app plus necessary dependencies, not the whole workspace.
构建阶段生成app；全新的运行阶段仅从前者复制app和已确认依赖。运行阶段未继承: The build stage produces app. A fresh runtime stage copies only app and confirmed dependencies from it, without inheriting source or compiler files. Temporary build credentials use secret mounts, not ARG or ENV.
验收清单分别检查非特权身份能启动、所需文件可读、材料清单不含凭据，并记录镜像摘要: The acceptance checklist covers non-privileged startup, required file access, no credentials in the contents inventory, and records digest D1, source commit C1 and lockfile version. These are planned checks, not a claim that a scan passed.
改进后的交付边界是可追溯的最小运行材料；秘密不曾进入镜像，比“最后删掉”更可靠。: The delivery boundary is a traceable minimum runtime inventory. Preventing secrets from entering the image is stronger than deleting them later. Runtime behavior still requires the listed checks.
容器能启动，且最新层已看不到.env，所以镜像没有秘密。: It starts and .env is absent in the newest layer, so the image has no secrets.
启动只验证部分行为；较早层、历史或构建材料仍可能保留凭据。: Startup covers only some behavior; earlier layers, history or build inputs may retain credentials.
从材料进入构建的路径预防泄漏，检查最终内容及历史，并记录固定摘要和验证结果。: Prevent exposure at the input boundary, inspect contents and history, and record a fixed digest with verification evidence.
预发布用D1通过验收；上线前latest已指向D2。怎样最能保持验收对象一致？: Staging passed with D1, but latest now points to D2. What best preserves the validated artifact?
继续用latest，名称相同就表示内容相同。: Use latest because the name is unchanged.
标签可以移动；同名不能证明上线的是D1。: Tags can move; the same name does not establish D1.
明确部署已验收的D1摘要，并核对实际运行摘要。: Deploy the validated D1 digest and check the running digest.
对：固定内容标识，再核对运行对象，才能连接验收证据与发布对象。: Correct: fixing content identity and checking the running artifact links validation to deployment.
源码文件名不能覆盖基础镜像、依赖与构建过程形成的差异。: Filenames do not capture differences in base images, dependencies or builds.
另一个报表服务运行只需dist和生产依赖，却把测试数据与私钥一起复制。写出材料分: A report service needs dist and production dependencies but copies test data and a private key. Describe input separation and pre-release checks.
构建阶段保留编译所需材料；运行阶段只接收dist及必要依赖；私钥不进构建上下文。: Keep build inputs in the build stage; send only dist and necessary dependencies to runtime. Exclude the private key from the context. Record the digest and check identity, dependencies, startup and key absence without claiming planned checks passed.
能说明哪些材料不应进入镜像及原因。: Explain which materials must not enter the image and why.
包含固定摘要、运行依赖及实际验证证据。: Include a fixed digest, runtime dependencies and actual validation evidence.
让探针分别回答启动、接流量和重启的问题: Separate startup, traffic readiness and restart decisions
启动探针回答初始化是否完成；就绪探针回答此刻能否接收流量；存活探针回答进程是否进: Startup probes check initialization; readiness checks current ability to receive traffic; liveness detects failures that should recover through restart. When configured, startup success gates readiness and liveness. Different actions require different judgments, even when all use HTTP status.
暂时依赖不可用不一定适合重启应用：把数据库短故障当成存活失败，会造成同时重启和额: A temporary dependency outage does not necessarily justify restarting the application: doing so can synchronize restarts and add load. Failed readiness removes normal service routing; liveness failure beyond its threshold can trigger restart. Set thresholds, periods and timeouts from measured startup distributions and failure modes.
45秒预热与一次短暂依赖故障: A 45-second warmup and a transient dependency fault
合成应用启动需45秒加载索引；预热期间不能处理搜索。预热后本地事件循环正常，但数: A synthetic search app needs 45 seconds to load an index and cannot serve during warmup. Later its event loop remains healthy during a 10-second database outage; another failure mode is a deadlocked event loop. The team wants neither premature traffic nor pointless restarts.
启动检查观察索引初始化标志，失败容忍窗口留出超过正常45秒的余量；不把周期乘次数: The startup check observes index initialization and allows margin beyond the normal 45 seconds. Period times count is not an exact restart timestamp. Readiness and liveness have not run before startup succeeds.
数据库短故障使关键搜索暂不可用，就绪检查转失败以停止常规路由；事件循环仍有响应，: The brief database fault makes critical search unavailable, so readiness fails to stop normal routing. The responsive event loop keeps liveness successful. Recheck readiness after dependency recovery rather than assuming it.
死锁使本地进展检查持续失败，可按存活策略重启。验证时分别注入预热、依赖短故障和死: A deadlock persistently fails the local progress check and can trigger restart under the liveness policy. Controlled validation separates warmup, dependency outage and deadlock, recording routing, restarts and real search results, not only probe colors.
三个场景对应三种判断：预热由启动保护，暂不可服务由就绪摘流量，不可进展由存活恢复: The three scenarios now have separate decisions: startup protects warmup, readiness withdraws traffic, and liveness handles inability to progress. Validate business requests separately.
只要数据库连不上，就让所有实例的存活探针失败。: Fail liveness on all instances whenever the database is unreachable.
重启不会修好远端数据库，还可能放大连接风暴与服务容量下降。: Restarting does not repair the remote database and can amplify reconnection storms and capacity loss.
依据服务依赖设计就绪条件；存活聚焦重启能改善的本地故障，并用故障场景验证。: Design readiness around service dependencies; reserve liveness for local failures a restart can improve, and validate with fault scenarios.
合成服务初始化已完成，消息下游短暂中断，但进程仍能响应本地进展检查。最合理的起点: Initialization is complete. A downstream queue is briefly unavailable while the local progress check succeeds. What is the best starting point?
评估关键业务是否可服务，必要时就绪失败；避免仅因下游短故障重启。: Assess critical service ability, fail readiness if necessary, and avoid restarting solely for the downstream transient.
对：先匹配故障与动作；还需检查该依赖是否真是当前请求的必需条件。: Correct: match the fault to the action, including whether that dependency is required for the current requests.
把启动标志重新改回未启动，永久跳过其他探针。: Reset startup forever to skip other probes.
启动保护初始化，不是运行时故障的通用开关；这样会掩盖后续健康问题。: Startup guards initialization, not all runtime faults; this would hide subsequent health issues.
让所有实例立即重启，一定恢复下游。: Restart every instance to guarantee downstream recovery.
应用重启不能保证远端恢复，反而可能减少可用容量。: Application restarts cannot guarantee remote recovery and may reduce capacity.
图片服务启动需加载模型，运行后可能模型线程死锁，也可能远端存储短故障。分别写探针: An image service loads a model at startup, may deadlock its model worker, or suffer a brief remote-storage fault. Specify probe decisions and evidence.
启动确认模型装载完成；就绪检查当前关键请求依赖；存活观察本地可恢复的无进展。受控: Startup checks model readiness; readiness checks current critical dependencies; liveness detects locally recoverable lack of progress. Controlled tests record routing, restarts and image-processing results without universal timeout claims.
清楚区分三种探针及失败后的不同动作。: Distinguish the three probes and their failure actions.
说明为什么重启能或不能改善该故障，并给业务验收。: Explain whether restart can help and include business acceptance checks.
读懂配置、状态与真实资源之间的差异: Read differences between configuration, state and real resources
基础设施配置描述期望结构；状态记录配置中的资源地址与远端对象之间的绑定及相关属性: Configuration describes intended infrastructure; state binds configuration addresses to remote objects and related attributes; real infrastructure is what the provider currently has. Manual changes, imports and stale state can separate them. Configuration is not proof of reality, and state is not a public document.
计划展示拟采取的变更，并不执行它们。原地更新与替换对象的风险不同，尤其数据库被替: A plan proposes changes without executing them. In-place updates and replacement have different risks. For a database, reverting configuration does not restore lost data. Review object identity, impact, retention and tested recovery; restrict access to sensitive state and plans.
一次看似改名却会替换数据库的计划: A naming change that proposes database replacement
纸面输入：配置资源db.main期望名称orders-v2；状态将db.main: Paper inputs: db.main intends the name orders-v2; state binds db.main to remote db-17; db-17 contains orders. The plan marks replacement, not an in-place update. A backup says created successfully but has not been restored in a test.
配置地址db.main不是数据库的永久业务身份；状态指向db-17，数据也在db: The configuration address db.main is not permanent business identity. State points to db-17 and its data. Check workspace, account, region and binding to avoid reviewing a different environment.
替换可能销毁旧对象再创建新对象，不能理解为只改显示名称。此时应暂停执行，调查哪个: Replacement may destroy and recreate the object; it is not merely a display-name change. Pause execution and investigate the forcing attribute, data retention and dependent connection changes.
补充隔离环境恢复演练、数据核对和经授权的迁移或避免替换方案，再重新生成并复核计划: Add an isolated restore rehearsal, data checks and an authorized migration or non-replacement proposal, then regenerate and review the plan. Backup existence is evidence, not proof of recovery objectives. No resource changes are performed in this lesson.
当前结论是“识别到未解决的数据风险，暂不执行”，不是“计划生成成功所以可以上线”: The conclusion is unresolved data risk and no execution, rather than permission to release because planning succeeded. State identity and recovery evidence guide the next decision.
把旧配置提交回来，就一定能恢复被替换数据库的订单。: Restoring the old configuration commit necessarily recovers orders after replacement.
配置描述结构，不包含原数据库全部业务数据；新建同名对象也不是旧对象复活。: Configuration describes structure, not all business data; recreating a name does not revive the old object.
分别准备配置回退、数据恢复和业务一致性验证，并由有权限者评审执行条件。: Prepare configuration rollback, data recovery and business consistency checks separately, with authorized review of execution conditions.
计划显示一个存储对象将被替换，但状态绑定指向与预期不同的环境。先做什么？: A plan proposes storage replacement, but state points to an unexpected environment. What comes first?
先执行，让新状态自动纠正环境。: Apply first and let new state correct the environment.
执行会对当前绑定对象产生影响，不能拿真实变更来消除身份疑问。: Execution affects the currently bound object; real changes must not resolve an identity uncertainty.
删掉状态文件，当作全新资源。: Delete state and treat everything as new.
丢失绑定可能产生重复或失管资源，也没有解释原对象与数据。: Losing bindings may create duplicates or unmanaged objects and does not account for original data.
停止执行，核对工作区、凭据、区域与资源绑定，再审查新计划。: Stop execution and verify workspace, credentials, region and resource bindings before reviewing a new plan.
对：先证明操作对象，才能讨论变更风险与恢复条件。: Correct: establish the target before assessing change and recovery risks.
缓存集群由人工扩容，但配置与状态读数不同。说明你要比对哪些证据，怎样避免直接覆盖: A cache cluster was manually expanded and configuration differs from state observations. Identify evidence to compare and avoid blindly overwriting reality.
确认环境和对象绑定，读取当前容量及变更记录，区分期望与实际；生成只读计划，评估容: Verify environment and binding, inspect current capacity and change records, distinguish intent from reality, review a read-only plan and assess shrink effects before proposing reviewed reconciliation.
区分配置、状态、真实资源，不把任何一者单独当成全部事实。: Distinguish configuration, state and reality without treating one as complete truth.
识别破坏性变更及恢复证据，不未经评审执行。: Identify destructive change and recovery evidence without unreviewed execution.
从四类信号做出有依据的告警判断: Make evidence-based alert decisions from four signal types
流量告诉你工作量及比例的分母；延迟描述完成请求要多久，应区分成功与失败并观察尾部: Traffic describes workload and denominators; latency measures completion time, including tails and success/failure distinctions; errors measure outcomes outside the contract; saturation measures proximity to capacity or queueing. CPU helps explain capacity but does not replace user outcomes.
告警要连接需要人处理的影响与具体动作。先定义关键路径、统计窗口、错误分母和持续条: Connect alerts to actionable impact. Define the critical path, window, error denominator and persistence, then an owner and investigation entry. A single low-volume failure and sustained high-volume failures need more than a shared percentage. A brief resource spike is not automatically a business incident.
CPU较低的窗口为什么更需要先处理: Why the lower-CPU window needs attention first
合成支付接口两个独立5分钟窗口：A有1000次有效请求、2次失败、成功请求p95: Two independent synthetic five-minute payment windows: A has 1,000 eligible requests, 2 failures, successful-request p95 220ms and peak CPU 90%; B has 200 requests, 12 failures, successful-request p95 900ms and peak CPU 45%. The exercise latency target is 500ms.
A错误率2/1000=0.2%，成功请求尾延迟在目标内；B为12/200=6%，: A error rate is 2/1,000=0.2% and its successful-request tail is within target. B is 12/200=6%, with 900ms above the exercise target. B has both failures and slow successes; lower CPU does not negate impact.
用资源信号解释而非替代结论: Use resource evidence to explain, not replace
A的CPU峰值值得查看持续时间与容量余量，不足以单独认定故障；B需查依赖超时、队: Investigate A’s CPU duration and headroom without calling the peak an incident by itself. For B, inspect dependency timeouts, queues and affected requests. The evidence does not establish CPU shortage as B’s cause.
记录B的路径、5分钟分母200、失败12、p95 900ms与观察时刻，交值班负: Record B’s route, five-minute denominator 200, failures 12, p95 900ms and observation time. Assign an on-call owner to verify impact and inspect requests/dependencies. Production thresholds need baselines and persistence; do not copy exercise values.
先处理B的用户影响，继续调查原因；A进入容量观察。这里区分了“需要处理什么”和“: Prioritize B’s user impact and investigate its cause; observe A’s capacity. This separates what needs action from what caused the problem.
CPU没超过80%，服务一定正常。: CPU below 80% means the service is healthy.
请求可能在等待网络、依赖或锁，CPU并不高；成功率和尾延迟仍可能恶化。: Requests may wait on networks, dependencies or locks with little CPU use while success and tail latency deteriorate.
以关键用户结果发现影响，以流量和饱和度辅助定位，再补充具有分母的告警证据。: Detect impact from critical outcomes, use traffic and saturation for diagnosis, and include denominators in alert evidence.
窗口C有1次失败/2次请求；窗口D有400次失败/10000次请求。最可靠的判断: Window C has 1 failure/2 requests; D has 400/10,000. What is the most reliable judgment?
C的50%大于D的4%，所以D无需处理。: C is 50% versus D’s 4%, so D needs no action.
忽略了失败规模与窗口稳定性；D可能有更广泛的用户影响。: This ignores failure volume and stability; D may have much broader impact.
补充关键路径、持续时间和用户影响，再决定紧急程度。: Add critical-path, duration and user-impact evidence before assigning urgency.
对：同时使用比例、数量和业务含义，避免低样本百分比误导。: Correct: combine rate, volume and business meaning to avoid low-sample distortion.
资源利用率无法回答这402次失败分别影响什么用户任务。: Resource utilization does not explain which user tasks the 402 failures affected.
下载服务失败率上升但CPU平稳。列出四类信号的观察项，并写出一条带负责人和排查入: Download failures rise with stable CPU. Specify observations for all four signal types and write an alert with an owner and investigation entry.
记录有效下载数与失败数、成功/失败延迟、等待存储的队列及资源余量；告警说明受影响: Record eligible downloads and failures, successful/failed latency, storage queues and headroom. State route, window, denominator and persistence, assigning the download on-call owner to relevant request and dependency records.
四类信号各有问题指向，不以CPU替代成功率。: Give each signal a purpose without substituting CPU for success.
告警包含用户影响、可解释分母及行动归属。: Include user impact, interpretable denominators and action ownership.
把可靠性目标换算成可解释的误差预算: Translate reliability targets into an interpretable error budget
SLI是你实际测量的服务表现；SLO是约定时间窗内希望达到的目标。本课以“好事件: An SLI measures service performance; an SLO is its target over an agreed window. Here the SLI is good events divided by eligible events. Define eligibility, success and measurement location first. Server-only logs can miss failures that never reach the server.
请求型误差预算=有效请求总数×(1−目标比例)，剩余预算再减实际坏事件数。时间型: For request-based objectives, budget equals eligible requests times one minus the target; subtract bad events for the remainder. Time-based indicators use eligible time, so request percentages do not directly imply downtime minutes. Budgets guide reliability tradeoffs, not permission to cause failures; owners agree policies and exceptions.
合成已结束统计窗共100000次有效结账请求；成功指正确完成且未超时，失败80次: A completed synthetic window has 100,000 eligible checkout requests. Success means correct completion without timeout; 80 failed. The target is 99.9%. The denominator is fixed; this is not next-window forecasting, and business-declined payments are not automatically system failures.
好事件数100000−80=99920，因此SLI=99920/100000=9: Good events are 100,000−80=99,920, giving SLI 99.92%. This counts request outcomes, not machine uptime.
预算100000×0.001=100次坏事件；已消耗80次，即80%；剩余100: The budget is 100,000×0.001=100 bad events. Eighty events consume 80%, leaving 20 events or 20%. These numbers belong to this fixed window.
把结果变成决策输入: Turn the ledger into a decision input
窗口达到目标，但预算已用去大部分。评审应同时看近期消耗速度、受影响用户与团队既定: The window meets the target but consumes most of its budget. Review recent burn, user impact and agreed policy; 20 remaining events do not establish a safe release. Recalculate for a new or rolling window using its own denominator.
结论是99.92%达到99.9%，已耗80%、剩余20%；它是可追溯的可靠性账本: The ledger shows 99.92% against 99.9%, with 80% consumed and 20% remaining. It is an auditable account, not a future-risk guarantee.
99.9%请求成功率等于每个月都可停机固定分钟数。: A 99.9% request-success target always grants a fixed number of downtime minutes each month.
请求量随时间变化，一分钟高峰与一分钟低峰影响的请求数不同；时间SLI与请求SLI: Traffic varies over time; peak and quiet minutes affect different request counts. Time- and request-based SLIs have different denominators.
写明SLI类型、统计窗及分母，在同一口径内计算，不跨指标直接换算。: State indicator type, window and denominator; calculate within the same contract without unsupported conversions.
另一个已结束窗口有20000次有效请求，目标99.5%，75次坏事件。剩余预算是: Another completed window has 20,000 eligible requests, a 99.5% target and 75 bad events. What remains?
对：20000×0.005=100，再减75得到25；口径是该固定窗口的请求事件: Correct: 20,000×0.005=100; subtract 75 to get 25 request events in this fixed window.
100次，因为目标只决定总预算。: 100 events because the target defines the total.
100是总预算，尚未扣除已发生的75次坏事件。: 100 is the total allowance before subtracting 75 bad events.
这里按请求计数，没有请求分布或时间SLI，不能得到分钟数。: This is request counting; neither a time SLI nor a traffic distribution supports minutes.
为报表导出设计一个SLI说明：用户关心正确生成且及时可下载。写清好事件、有效事件: Design an SLI for report exports that must be correct and promptly downloadable. Define good/eligible events, window and blind spots, then give a small ledger.
例如在明确的7天窗内，以被接受的有效导出任务为分母，5分钟内生成正确文件且可下载: For a specified seven-day window, use accepted eligible export jobs as denominator; good means a correct downloadable file within five minutes. Monitor submission failures separately to cover users without created jobs. Calculate targets and budgets under that definition with owner review.
好事件有可观察标准，分母及时间窗明确。: Use observable good-event criteria with a clear denominator and window.
计算一致并说明盲区，不把示例目标说成通用标准。: Keep calculations consistent, state blind spots and avoid universal target claims.
把指标、日志与追踪连成一条证据链: Connect metrics, logs and traces into an evidence chain
指标适合看整体规模、趋势与分组差异；日志描述离散事件及上下文；追踪用一组带父子关: Metrics show aggregate volume, trends and cohorts; logs describe events and context; traces use related spans to describe a request path. trace_id links a trace and span_id identifies a step. A slow trace provides a lead, not automatic evidence about every user.
span持续时间不是随意相加的账单：并行跨度会重叠，父span可能包含子span: Span durations cannot be added indiscriminately: parallel spans overlap, parents contain children, and uninstrumented gaps may remain. Sampling, propagation gaps and collection loss reduce coverage. Missing records mean not observed, not necessarily did not occur. Correlation fields should not carry secrets.
合成追踪T7：入口span为0–500ms；身份检查子span为0–40ms；数: Synthetic trace T7: entry span 0–500ms; authentication child 0–40ms; database child 40–460ms; the final interval is uninstrumented. Log L9 includes trace_id=T7 and connection waiting. Query p95 rises in the same window, but versions have not been compared.
沿相同请求关联记录: Link records for the same request
T7与L9通过明确trace_id相连，不是仅凭相近时间。得到一条请求里的数据库: T7 and L9 share an explicit trace_id rather than only nearby times. This supports database waiting in one request; other logs still need their own correlation evidence.
身份40ms，数据库420ms，尾部剩余40ms未解释。两个子span本题为串行: Authentication is 40ms, database 420ms, and the final 40ms is unexplained. These children are sequential and non-overlapping; do not add the 500ms parent to get 960ms. The database span is not necessarily all database execution.
从单例回到整体并验证假设: Return from a trace to the population
按版本、请求类型比较同窗口样本与查询指标，检查连接池等待和数据库执行分解。当前可: Compare same-window traces and query metrics by version and request type; separate pool wait from execution. Say the database-related path deserves investigation, not that database code is proven to cause every slow request.
证据链给出T7→L9→同窗指标的联系，并保留40ms观测缺口与样本代表性问题；下: The chain links T7, L9 and same-window metrics while retaining the 40ms gap and representativeness questions, making the next investigation concrete.
